task.description: Validate TEST-DESIGNER's test design (Step 3). Hard gate — TEST-RUNNER cannot proceed until PASS. Check: (1) every MUST requirement has a runnable integration test file, (2) no error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests without counterpart integration test, (3) all fixtures use per-test UUIDs, (4) tests clean up after themselves, (5) tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement has runnable integration test
No skipped MUST tests without alternative integration test

result.summary: All 13 MUST requirements (REPO-01 through REPO-13) have fully runnable integration tests with real PostgreSQL. No skipped tests. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs. All tests clean up via transaction rollback. Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent.
